name: Inbound webhook
description: Get a private address. Other tools post to it, and TITAN treats each post as an event.

auth.setupNote: TITAN makes a long random path for you. Anyone who has the full address can post to it, so treat it like a password. If you want the sender to sign the body, choose a signing secret.

fields.name: label
fields.label: Name
fields.help: A short name that shows in the event list.

fields.name: signing_secret
fields.label: Signing secret
fields.help: Optional. TITAN checks the header X-Hub-Signature-256, as GitHub sends it.
